result:
Gate passed (9 findings, 2 P0). Both files written to `product/ux/`.

**Verdict:** Nimbus Notes tells both users their note is saved, then loses it, so neither persona reached value and both quit inside seven minutes.

**Count by severity** (9 blocks; 7 issues, 2 split on persona flip):
- P0 × 2 — Save toast with no persisted note (both personas); false Memories facts (novice variant)
- P1 × 2 — false Memories facts (power-user variant); irreversible undefined workspace-type choice at signup (novice variant)
- P2 × 4 — cards/blocks/notes naming; empty dashboard with no CTA; undefined Settings toggles; no keyboard shortcuts
- P3 × 1 — workspace-type choice (power-user variant)

**Score:** 2/10.

**Dropped for want of evidence:** search broken independently of save (no note ever persisted, can't separate); toast dismissing too fast (`04-note-saved-toast.png` shows no toast, no timing); save-redirect-to-dashboard as its own A3 issue (no persona comment); settings defaults not following signup choice (identical checkbox states across two workspace types, unprobed).

**Notes for the orchestrator:** persona_mode is generic, flagged on the face of both files. Layer B applied only to the Memories surface. Manifest is still open (`phase: 2a-capture`) — the gate suggests running `close_run.py`; I did not touch it.
